html:
The overthrow of President Mohamed Bazoum by his presidential guard, led by General Abdourahamane Tchiani, on 26 July 2023 in Niamey.

Bazoum's 2021 election had been Niger's first handover between elected presidents. ECOWAS imposed sanctions and threatened to use force, but did not. The junta expelled French troops by the end of 2023 and American troops in 2024, and turned to Russia. With the juntas of Mali and Burkina Faso it formed the Alliance of Sahel States and left ECOWAS. Bazoum remained a prisoner. Jihadist attacks in the west of the country continued. See also Arlit.
sum: The overthrow of President Mohamed Bazoum by his presidential guard, led by General Abdourahamane Tchiani, on 26 July 2023 in Niamey.
